description: IQ Sell My Car helps you understand what your vehicle may be worth and connect with a nationwide dealer network. Enter your VIN, mileage, ZIP code, and vehicle condition to receive market-based retail, private-party, and estimated dealer-offer values. When you're ready, submit your vehicle to participating dealerships after providing explicit consent. Your vehicle is not publicly listed on IQAutoDeals.com. After submission, you'll receive an email with a secure link to upload photos and activate your seller listing.
